slides.s: PMP-Certified Engineering Leader | 21 Years in Software, DevOps & AI-Driven Engineering Transformation
slides.n: Welcome to {name}'s professional journey. With 21 years of progressive experience and 8 years in engineering management, {name} has built high-performing teams and delivered enterprise-scale products across monolithic and distributed architectures, most recently driving Agentic AI transformation in engineering.

items: F5 Innovation India · Jul 2025-Sep 2026 — Led a 10-member team on BIG-IP control plane services, cut upgrade time ~90%, drove security hardening (DAC/MAC, SELinux) reducing 100+ CVEs/defects, and built 7-8 agentic AI agents for automated issue resolution.

Cisco Systems India · Mar 2020-Jul 2025 — Owned architecture and delivery of Webex-Microsoft Teams presence/calling integration using Kafka, Redis, and Java; led WebRTC-based Webex Connect solutions for healthcare and AI-driven SDK code generation initiatives.

Cisco Systems India · Apr 2018-Feb 2020 — Led developers, testers, and release engineers on Cisco Expressway gateway, driving Python/C++ platform features, Erlang-based DB upgrades, and DevOps-driven build/release improvements.

Cisco Systems India · Apr 2008-Feb 2018 — Owned functional, regression, and automation testing for Cisco Call Manager and Expressway, handled customer escalations with SIP/H.323/RTP protocol troubleshooting, and drove automation coverage toward 100%.
Verizon & Alcatel India · 2007-2008 — Performed end-to-end call-flow, functional, and regression testing for IP-converged contact center and Alcatel OmniPCX PBX solutions.
slides.n: {name}'s career spans two decades, evolving from hands-on QA and protocol testing roles into engineering leadership. Along the way, {he} built and led teams delivering complex VoIP, cloud, and AI-driven platforms, consistently focused on reliability, security, and customer experience.

Over the years, {name} has developed deep technical expertise spanning VoIP protocols, cloud-native DevOps tooling, and modern AI technologies. {He} combines strong hands-on engineering with proven leadership in guiding teams through complex technical transformations.

{name}'s impact is reflected in measurable outcomes-cutting upgrade times by nearly 90%, resolving over 100 long-standing defects and CVEs, and building a suite of AI agents that transformed how {his} team approached issue resolution and delivery.

{name}'s foundation combines a strong engineering degree with continuous learning, including a PMP certification and a recent postgraduate program in Artificial Intelligence from the University of Texas at Austin-reflecting {his} commitment to staying at the forefront of technology.

That concludes {name}'s professional story-from protocol-level QA engineering to leading AI-driven engineering transformation. Thank you for taking the time to learn about {his} journey and the impact {he} has delivered throughout {his} career.
